areas.problem: 2 text element(s) below WCAG AA, e.g. "AM" 3.24:1, "Update password" 3.24:1
areas.fix: Darken text to reach 4.5:1 (3:1 for 24px+ text). Muted grey on white: ~#5B6B82 or darker. Check text on tinted backgrounds too.

areas.problem: 23 tap target(s) under 44px on phone, 7 under 24px on desktop: LABEL, Profile, Password, Notifications, Upload photo
areas.fix: Add `@media (max-width:640px),(pointer:coarse){button,.btn,input,select,[role=tab],nav a{min-height:44px}}`; give icon buttons and small links 44x44 padding.
Find the wide element: add `min-width:0` to flex/grid children, `overflow-x:auto` to chip/date rows, turn wide tables into cards on phones.
Add `:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent);outline-offset:2px}`; never remove outlines without a replacement.
Nothing below 12px. Body 16px (14px only in dense desktop tools); phone inputs 16px.
Use the scale 12/14/16/18/20/24/30/36/48/60 and only 4-6 sizes per screen (7 on marketing pages).
Give every input a visible <label for> above it (a placeholder is not a label); icon-only controls get aria-label.

areas.problem: Only 57% of spacing values are on the 4px grid
areas.fix: Use only 4, 8, 12, 16, 24, 32, 48, 64, 96 for padding, margin and gap (best as CSS variables).
One <h1> per page, then h2, h3 in order; use header/nav/main landmarks.
Add a `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)` block; list transition properties instead of `all`.
Use SVG icons from one set, realistic content and real images; drop gradient text.
